<!-- Generated by apps/docs/scripts/generate-ui-reference.mjs. -->

Use shadcn.Chart for a line, area, bar, or pie from JSON. Every x must be a unique string or finite number. Each series needs a unique nonempty id and a nonempty key. Every y must be finite or explicitly null. Use one nonnegative series for pie. Invalid data displays an error. Hex colors, CSS color names, and var(--chart-1) through var(--chart-5) are accepted as color strings. Values outside the supported syntax fall back to the palette. Chart.Container requires CSS-safe IDs and config keys (letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens) and valid CSS colors. Use the native Tooltip inside a LayerChart tooltip snippet under Chart.Container in Svelte.

## Usage

```ts
import { chart, components } from '@viewstem/svelte-ui/shadcn/chart';
```

The set ID is `shadcn/chart`. It [registers](../../registration/) 2 components for use in JSON.

## JSON reference

Inputs without **Required** are optional. In a type, `?` marks an optional object field. **Default** shows a literal default declared by the Svelte wrapper. Other defaults are unspecified here and may come from the underlying component, the browser, or other inputs.

<a id="shadcn-chart-container"></a>

### `shadcn.Chart.Container`

Native exports include `components.ChartContainer`, `components.Container`.

| Input | JSON type | Details |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `config` | `object` · [fields](#shadcn-chart-container-config-fields) | **Required** · serializable values only |
| `aria-label` | `null \| string` |  |
| `class` | `string` |  |
| `id` | `null \| string` |  |
| `placeholder` | `null \| string` |  |
| `text` | `string` |  |

Key `config` by series ID. Each entry can provide a tooltip `label`, a single `color`, or a `theme` with both `light` and `dark` colors. The container exposes each color as `--color-<series ID>`. For example, `{"visits":{"label":"Visits","color":"var(--chart-1)"}}` exposes `--color-visits`. The native Tooltip reads the configuration when it resolves a series label.

Slots `default`.

The [DOM events for this part](../../attributes/#dom-67a0f1612c) use a [direct payload](../../support/#event-payloads).

<a id="shadcn-chart"></a>

### `shadcn.Chart`

This is a JSON composition.

| Input | JSON type | Details |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | `Array<object>` | Default `[]` |
| `kind` | `"line" \| "bar" \| "area" \| "pie"` | Default `"line"` |
| `label` | `string` | Default `"Chart"` |
| `series` | `Array<{ id: string, key: string, label?: string, color?: string }>` | Default `[]` · `[]` no extra fields |
| `x` | `string` | Default `"x"` |

No slots.

No events.

#### Example View

```json
{
  "render": {
    "id": "example",
    "componentRef": "shadcn.Chart",
    "inputs": {
      "kind": "bar",
      "label": "Weekly visits",
      "x": "day",
      "data": [
        {
          "day": "Mon",
          "visits": 17
        },
        {
          "day": "Tue",
          "visits": 23
        }
      ],
      "series": [
        {
          "id": "visits",
          "key": "visits",
          "label": "Visits"
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

<a id="native-context"></a>

## Parts that require native context

Use these exports in Svelte. This set provides them as native components without JSON adapter registration.

| Catalog part | Native exports | Usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Tooltip` | `components.ChartTooltip`, `components.Tooltip` | Requires both Chart.Container and LayerChart context. indicator defaults to dot. The formatter snippet receives value, name, item, index, and payload. The labelFormatter function receives the value and series payload array. |

## Native types and composition

In Svelte, use `ComponentProps<typeof components.ChartContainer>` for the native prop type. Snippets, function props, DOM refs, and bindings follow the native types.

Namespace type exports `components.ChartConfig`.

- `components.getPayloadConfigFromPayload` · Looks up the matching ChartConfig entry for a native tooltip series and key. Takes config, payload, key, and optional row data. Returns the matched config entry or undefined.
